name: What should I compare when choosing a ceiling painter?

mainEntity.name: What should I compare when choosing a ceiling painter?

acceptedAnswer.text: A good ceiling job depends on **prep quality**, the number of coats included, and whether the painter uses the right product for the room. Ask how they handle stains, cracks, high ceilings, dust control, and cleanup before you compare bids.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare prep work, number of coats, stain handling, cleanup, and experience with tall or damaged ceilings.
